probe.epsilonReason: Eight Float32 ulps at the native image extent cover published-buffer rounding, not a visible-pixel allowance.
probe.scope: Nearest anatomical attachments and proximal limb-to-axial body-skin attachments, independently enumerated from every nonzero source-alpha edge. Distinct limb-to-limb and distal limb-to-body silhouette boundaries are observation-only; they are not required welds.
